next.handoff.pickNote: A {agent} model is not a switch: a new chat opens with this one's context
next.handoff.hint.excerpt: The first request, the latest turns in full and the results of key commands, within the new model's window. No reasoning or attachments.
next.handoff.hint.note: This chat's agent writes a note: goal, decisions, state, next steps, files, how to verify, gotchas. The chat itself does not change.
next.handoff.hint.result: The branch's agent writes what was done, the files touched and the decisions made. The result joins the original chat's queue.
next.handoff.hint.history: The new agent reads the complete transcript from a private file. The history is not loaded into this page.
next.handoff.writing: The agent is writing the note; this can take a couple of minutes…
next.handoff.historyReady: The complete transcript is ready in a private file.
next.handoff.textLabel: The text the chat starts with
next.handoff.title: Continue in {model}
next.handoff.lead: A new chat in the same folder starts with this text. The chat on {from} stays as it is.
next.handoff.mergeLead: This branch's result goes to the original chat as a message, into its queue.
next.handoff.continue.title: Continue in another model
next.handoff.continue.lead: A new chat starts with this one's context. This chat stays as it is.
next.moveVm.title: Continue on another machine
next.moveVm.lead: A new chat with this one's history opens on the machine you pick. This chat becomes read-only.
next.moveVm.timeout: The machine takes too long to answer
next.moveVm.sourceBusy: The agent is still working. Wait for the answer or stop it.
next.moveVm.noHistory: This chat has no history yet.
next.moveVm.sourceDirty: The chat's folder has uncommitted changes, which a move does not carry yet.
next.moveVm.filesHint: The repository or commit is not on this machine. The chat starts with its history in an empty folder.
next.moveVm.reason.unsupported: The machine is not updated yet
next.moveVm.here.off: “{machine}” is off — the history is read-only. You can continue here once it is back.
next.moveVm.here.notTarget: This machine is not among your connected ones — the chat cannot move here.
